Majors and Programs in IS&T
Find Your Place in Computing
The College of Information Science and Technology offers an exciting array of traditional ( ) and online ( ) master's, doctoral and certificate programs to prepare graduate students for a wide range of careers in the field of computing and information technology.
Request Further Information
Apply Today
Artificial Intelligence
Artificial Intelligence is transforming every industry — and reshaping the future of work along with it. Our Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence program immerses you in the technologies driving this revolution
Delivery Mode
Traditional
Master of Science
Biomedical Informatics
Advance research and practice in contemporary information and knowledge management that impact Biomedical, clinical and translational research, health care services, health care practice, public health care, and health care delivery.
Delivery Mode
Traditional
Master of Science
Doctor of Philosophy
Computer Science
Build the software of tomorrow. Develop advanced technical and collaborative skills in machine learning, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, human-computer interaction, and software engineering.
Delivery Modes
Traditional
Online

Computer Science Education
Hone your skills in teaching K-12 computer science topics including coding, cybersecurity, digital citizenship and more while also completing your supplemental teaching endorsement in information technology.
Delivery Modes
Traditional
Online

Computing & Information Science
Advance the state of the art in computing while working closely with world-class faculty to deepen your basic and applied research abilities to prepare you for a future in academic and industry research settings.
Delivery Mode
Traditional

Cybersecurity
Protect what matters in the digital age. Gain comprehensive skills in designing and developing secure software and hardware along with proactive defense strategies to protect mission-critical data and systems across organizations, government agencies, and enterprises.

Traditional

Data Science
Deepen your skills in data analytics, business intelligence, machine learning, and information visualization to understand target audiences, personalize marketing and experiences, and identify hidden patterns.

Human-Centered Computing
Combine your prior knowledge from any discipline with skills in user experience design, rapid prototyping, and creativity to help drive technology product innovation and entrepreneurship.

Align technology with business objectives. Learn software project management, data management, cloud and enterprise architecture, and analytics to help organizations build and sustain effective, mission-driven technology solutions.

Certificate Programs
IS&T's certificates provide focused short-term programs of study for individuals seeking to improve their expertise, advance in position and salary, and expand their educational background. In addition, coursework for certificates may be applicable to a master's degree.
